description: Free model answers, no key needed. Answers are short (400 tokens), with a small daily allowance shared per network and a shared daily budget that can run out. To pay for a model answer with your key use chat with the same model without the free/ prefix.

max_tokens.description: Longest answer, in tokens (1 to 400, default 400).

messages.description: A whole conversation instead of prompt: text messages, oldest first.

model.description: A free model id such as deepseek-v4.1-flash; the free/ prefix is added if missing. Defaults to free/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

prompt.description: The question, as one user message. Send exactly one of prompt or messages.

name: chat_free
title: Chat (free)
